Restyle a single ggplot made by Seurat

Source: R/single_cell_visualize.R
manipulate_sc_plot.Rd

Removes the axes, legend or grid of one ggplot (e.g. from Seurat::DimPlot()), restores a hidden legend, or sets the legend position and title. Used by format_sc_plots on each plot of a list; only valid for individual ggplot objects.

Usage

manipulate_sc_plot(
  plot,
  remove.axes = FALSE,
  remove.legend = FALSE,
  remove.grid = FALSE,
  restore.legend = FALSE,
  legend.position = NULL,
  legend.title = NULL,
  legend.title.size = 12,
  legend.title.bold = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

plot

A single ggplot object

remove.axes

Whether to remove the axes, default is FALSE

remove.legend

Whether to remove the legend, default is FALSE

remove.grid

Whether to remove the grid, default is FALSE

restore.legend

Whether to restore the legend, default is FALSE

legend.position

The position of the legend, default is NULL (meaning no change)

legend.title

The title of the legend, default is NULL

legend.title.size

The size of the legend title, default is 12

legend.title.bold

Whether to bold the legend title, default is TRUE

...

Deprecated snake_case names of the arguments above (e.g. `remove_axes`), accepted with a warning; renamed to dot.case in 0.10.0

Value

a ggplot object with the axes, legend, and grid manipulated
